en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing food, dishes or clothes
ex: She put the clean plates back in the cupboard.
她把洗好的盤子放回碗櫃。

en: n. a place where milk is kept and butter or cheese is made; a farm that produces milk; milk, cheese and other products made from milk; a. relating to milk products
ex: The farm sells fresh milk to the local dairy.
農場把新鮮牛奶賣給當地的乳品廠。

en: n. a wall built across a river to hold back water and form a lake; a barrier that stops something; v. to hold back water with a dam; to block or stop something
ex: The dam provides electricity for the whole region.
這座水壩供應整個地區的電力。

en: v. to have enough courage to do something; to challenge someone to do something dangerous or difficult; n. a challenge to do something difficult or risky
ex: Nobody dared to speak when the teacher was angry.
老師生氣時沒有人敢開口。

en: n. a person who is loved very much; someone who is popular or admired by a group; a. much loved; very attractive or charming
ex: The little girl is the darling of the whole family.
那個小女孩是全家的寶貝。

en: v. to run or go somewhere very quickly; to hit something violently; to destroy someone's hopes; n. a sudden quick movement; a short race; a small amount of something added; a punctuation mark (—)
ex: He dashed to the station to catch the last train.
他衝向車站趕最後一班火車。

en: a large amount of information stored in a computer system in a way that makes it easy to search and use
ex: The company keeps all customer records in a database.
公司把所有客戶紀錄都存在資料庫裡。

en: a person or business that buys and sells goods; (in card games) the person who gives out the cards; someone who sells illegal drugs
ex: He works as a car dealer in the city.
他在市區當汽車經銷商。

en: a period of ten years, especially a period such as 1990 to 1999; a group of ten
ex: Prices have risen sharply over the last decade.
物價在過去十年間大幅上漲。

en: to make something look more attractive by adding nice things to it; to paint or put new paper on the walls of a room; to give someone a medal as an honor
ex: We decorated the Christmas tree with colored lights.
我們用彩色燈泡裝飾聖誕樹。

en: n. something that someone does, especially something very good or very bad; a legal document that shows who owns a house or land; v. (US) to give property to someone by a legal document
ex: He was praised for his good deeds.
他的善行受到稱讚。

en: to become deeper or make something deeper; to become stronger or more serious; (of a feeling) to become more intense
ex: The crisis deepened as the weeks went by.
隨著幾週過去，危機愈來愈嚴重。

en: n. a system of government in which people vote to choose the people who rule them; a country with this kind of government; fair and equal treatment of everyone in an organization
ex: Taiwan is known for its vibrant democracy.
台灣以活力十足的民主制度聞名。

en: a. based on or supporting the idea that all people have equal rights and should be able to take part in decisions; relating to a system of government chosen by the people; (Democratic) relating to a US political party
ex: The country held its first democratic election last year.
這個國家去年舉行了第一次民主選舉。

en: n. an amount of money that you put in a bank; an amount of money that you pay first when you are buying something; a layer of a substance left by a liquid; v. to put money into a bank account; to leave something somewhere; to leave a layer of something
ex: She made a deposit of five hundred dollars at the bank.
她在銀行存了五百美元。

en: a person whose job is to make plans or drawings for how something will be made, such as clothes, buildings or products
ex: She works as a fashion designer in Paris.
她在巴黎擔任時裝設計師。

en: a. wanted or worth having because it is useful, attractive or good; worth wanting or doing
ex: A quiet neighborhood is a desirable place to live.
安靜的社區是理想的居住地點。

en: n. a strong feeling that you want something; a request or wish; v. to want something very much; to ask for something formally
ex: She has a strong desire to travel around the world.
她非常渴望環遊世界。

en: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used; to end someone's hopes or career; to kill an animal because it is sick or dangerous
ex: The storm destroyed hundreds of homes.
暴風雨摧毀了數百間房屋。

en: n. an evil spirit; (the Devil) the most powerful evil spirit in some religions; (informal) a cruel or wicked person; (informal) a person who is full of mischief; v. to annoy someone
ex: According to the story, he made a deal with the devil.
按照故事，他和魔鬼做了交易。
ph: between the devil and the deep blue sea

en: a US or Canadian coin that is worth ten cents
ex: He gave the child a dime to buy candy.
他給了孩子一枚十分錢硬幣去買糖。

en: v. to eat dinner or a main meal; to have a formal meal; to give someone dinner
ex: We dined at a seafood restaurant by the harbor.
我們在港邊的海鮮餐廳用餐。

en: v. to put something into a liquid for a short time; to go down to a lower level; to put your hand into something to take something out; n. a short swim; a sauce for dipping food; a downward slope
ex: She dipped the brush into the paint.
她把刷子浸到顏料裡。

en: n. any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust; loose earth or soil; (informal) unpleasant information about someone
ex: His shoes were covered in dirt after the hike.
健行之後他的鞋子沾滿泥土。

en: a. not telling the truth or not able to be trusted; likely to cheat or deceive people
ex: It was dishonest of him to take credit for her work.
他把她的成果當成自己的功勞，這很不誠實。

en: v. to not like someone or something; n. a feeling of not liking someone or something
ex: I dislike getting up early on weekends.
我不喜歡週末早起。

en: n. a long narrow hole dug at the side of a road or field to carry water away; v. to dig a ditch; (informal) to get rid of something; to leave a person or thing behind; to land a plane on water
ex: The car slid off the road into a ditch.
那輛車滑出道路掉進溝裡。

en: v. to jump into water with your head and arms first; to go underwater; to move down quickly; n. an act of diving; a sudden drop; a cheap place to go, especially a bar
ex: The children dived into the pool one after another.
孩子們一個接一個跳進泳池。

en: n. a place where ships stop to load and unload; the place in a court where the person accused of a crime stands; a plant with long leaves; v. to bring a ship into a harbor; to join two spacecraft in space; to take money away from a worker's pay
ex: The ship docked at the pier early in the morning.
船清晨靠上碼頭。

en: n. a measured amount of medicine or a drug taken at one time; a particular amount of something; v. to give someone a dose of medicine
ex: Take one dose of the medicine three times a day.
這種藥每天服用三次，每次一劑。

en: a. feeling uncertain or not sure about something; not likely to happen or be true; not clearly good or honest
ex: I'm doubtful that the plan will succeed.
我懷疑這個計畫能不能成功。

en: a small sweet cake shaped like a ring or ball, cooked in hot oil
ex: We bought a box of doughnuts for the office.
我們買了一盒甜甜圈給辦公室。

en: n. the central part of a city, where most of the stores and offices are; a. in or relating to the center of a city; adv. to or in the central part of a city
ex: She works in an office downtown.
她在市中心的一間辦公室上班。

en: v. to pull something heavy along the ground; to move slowly or with difficulty; to make something seem longer or boring; n. a person or thing that is boring or annoying; a puff on a cigarette; a street (slang)
ex: He dragged the heavy bag across the floor.
他把沉重的袋子拖過地板。

en: a large insect with a long thin body and two pairs of wings, often seen near water
ex: A dragonfly landed on the lotus leaf.
一隻蜻蜓停在荷葉上。

en: a. very sudden or surprising; exciting and impressive; relating to plays and the theater; (of a person's behavior) trying to attract attention
ex: There has been a dramatic increase in house prices.
房價出現戲劇性的大幅上漲。

en: v. to fall in small drops; to let liquid fall in small drops; n. a small drop of liquid; a slow, steady fall of drops; a piece of equipment that gives a patient liquid through a tube
ex: Water was dripping from the roof.
水正從屋頂滴下來。

en: v. to die under water because you cannot breathe; to kill someone by holding them under water; to cover something completely with water; to cover a sound by making a louder noise
ex: Two children nearly drowned in the river.
兩個孩子差點在河裡溺水。

en: n. (US) a store that sells medicine, and also often sells food, drinks, newspapers and other goods
ex: I stopped at the drugstore to buy some cold medicine.
我順路到藥妝店買一些感冒藥。

en: a. having drunk too much alcohol so that you cannot control your behavior; n. a person who is drunk; (past participle of drink)
ex: He was too drunk to drive home.
他醉得沒辦法開車回家。
